reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Monitoring systems scraping the `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` metric will no longer receive data; the metric is available under the new name `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`.

proposed.statement: The `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` metric has been renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`.
